Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the locomotion of this existing native64 pixel-art creature. The user explicitly confirms it is NOT BIPEDAL: it moves on ALL FOUR EXISTING LIMBS.
Input1 exact current identity/color/proportion master. Input2 older original identity detail, same creature, for the FOUR low supports. NEVER copy a humanoid walk. Preserve this short rounded dark charcoal/maroon-backed creature, warm peach/brown low belly, original hooked curved head and tiny pale eye at front, four short strong clawed limbs. NO extra limbs, tail, horn, wing, clothes, armor or weapon.
CRITICAL ANATOMY: the front limbs are FOREPAWS that bear weight. BOTH forepaws remain at ground level along with hind paws; NEVER lift the forequarters into an upright two-legged posture, never leave the two front limbs hanging as arms. Body horizontal/low, belly close to ground, shoulders and rump near same low height, body weight supported by THREE or FOUR paws during transitions. Original near-square overall silhouette39wide40high INCLUDING curved head, but actual trunk is LOW and wide under crest. No human torso, waist, long legs, upright chest, stand-up phase, rearing, hopping, trotting jump or human feet. Keep existing paw anatomy, low body volume, head shape and dark native palette.
Draw EXACT3equal columns x3equal rows, row-major first8DISTINCT full-body phases, ninth low four-paw idle. Compact deliberate FOUR-PAW stepping cycle:1forepaw right and hind left planted,2body settles over three planted paws,3forepaw left advances LOW while other paws support,4opposite diagonal group sets down,5stable opposite support,6body shifts low over three paws,7forepaw right advances low with hind left following,8returns to first four-paw contact. 400ms per advancement,800ms complete cycle. Tiny body bob, stable volume/camera/scale, no lifting both forepaws simultaneously. Draw whole coherent figures, no leg grafts, detached head or band shifts.
Style exact muted matte crisp readable native64 pixel clusters and original deep shadows. NO brighter/whiter skin, silver highlights, gloss, glow, blur, smooth HDpainting or3D. Colored fringe specks in masters are export specks, not anatomy or lights.
Genuine transparent alphaZERO background including gaps, complete figures with generous blank margins, no clipping or overlap. NO ground, shadow, labels, text, grid, checkerboard, matte or watermark.
DIRECTION: All first8figures walking DOWN/TOWARD VIEWER, slight elevated front-three-quarter camera like master. Show low front body, same hooked face/eye angle, TWO WEIGHT-BEARING FOREPAWS nearest viewer and TWO HIND PAWS further back visible at sides. Front paws stay grounded and support trunk; no upright belly.
